description: Return one full peptide, publication, finding or trial record by PEP-, PUB-, FND- or TRL- ID. A peptide slug, PMID or NCT number also works. Use this for known records or fields omitted from compact results. Use resolve_peptide instead for an unclear name, or search_publications to find papers. as_of_seq selects an earlier data_seq. Use replay_query instead to repeat a saved search.

as_of_seq.description: Read the data as it was at this data_seq. Use it to reproduce an earlier answer.

id.description: Record ID. IDs start with PEP-, PUB-, FND- or TRL-. A peptide slug, a PMID or an NCT number also works.
